author: Dr Alan Black
description:
Online weight-loss firms are flooding the market with illegal ads for prescription drugs, banking millions – then shrugging off toothless regulatory slaps. When will enforcers get serious? asks Dr Alan Black.

The post Britain’s Weight-Loss Pill Pushers Are Making Millions While Regulators Look the Other Way appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Britain’s Weight-Loss Pill Pushers Are Making Millions While Regulators Look the Other Way

author: Toby Young
description:
Prince Harry and six co-claimants, including Baroness Lawrence, must pay £9.5 million to Associated Newspapers in the next seven days after a judge ruled their hacking case was unreasonable to a high degree.

The post Prince Harry and Fellow Claimants Must Pay £9.5 million to Mail After Judge Rules Hacking Case Was ‘Unreasonable to a High Degree’ appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Prince Harry and Fellow Claimants Must Pay £9.5 million to Mail After Judge Rules Hacking Case Was ‘Unreasonable to a High Degree’

author: Steven Tucker
description:
Shiloh Hendrix got a $1,000 fine and 200 hours of community service for using a racial slur. The Somali man who filmed her had rape charges dropped "in the interest of justice". Only in Minnesota, says Steven Tucker.

The post In Minnesota, Words Matter More Than Rape appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: In Minnesota, Words Matter More Than Rape

author: Toby Young
description:
Baroness Sue Gray says working in Starmer’s No 10 was unbearable because no one could be trusted: "It just got to the point where, you know, everything you say, you feel somebody is recording it."

The post Sue Gray Says Working in Starmer’s No 10 Was ‘Unbearable’ appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Sue Gray Says Working in Starmer’s No 10 Was ‘Unbearable’

author: Toby Young
description:
Being attacked by your opponents is one thing. Being turned on by your allies is another. For that reason, the coverage in the left wing media would have been more painful for Jason Arday than in the right wing media.

The post For Jason Arday, Attacks in the ‘Left Wing Media’ Must Have Been Harder to Take Than Attacks in the ‘Right Wing Media’ appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: For Jason Arday, Attacks in the ‘Left Wing Media’ Must Have Been Harder to Take Than Attacks in the ‘Right Wing Media’

author: Paul Homewood
description:
The ONS quietly axed its annual excess winter death reports after 2022. Why? asks Paul Homewood. Could it be because they vastly outstrip the number of people that die during summer heat waves?

The post The Cover-Up of Winter Excess Death Data appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: The Cover-Up of Winter Excess Death Data

author: Richard Eldred
description:
